name: context-drift
description: Finds stale facts in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Cursor and Copilot rules, such as missing npm scripts, make targets and paths, the wrong package manager, or wrong Node/Python/Go versions. Runs locally with no network.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Context Drift never runs git: CD006 (stale file) is off and git-based filtering of ignored and sparse paths is skipped. All other checks only read files inside the workspace.

contextDrift.enable.description: Check agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules, Cursor/Copilot/Cline/Windsurf rules, SKILL.md) for drift.

enumDescriptions: Command drift: script, make target, just recipe or task does not exist
Path drift: referenced file or folder does not exist
Package manager drift: file says npm/pnpm/yarn/bun, lockfile says another
Version drift: Node/Python/Go claim contradicts .nvmrc, engines, .python-version, go.mod
Cross-file conflict: two instruction files give different commands for the same verb
Stale file: not changed for a long time while the repo kept moving

contextDrift.ignoreRules.description: Rule ids to skip, for example ["CD005", "CD006"].

contextDrift.useGit.description: Use read-only git (`git check-ignore`, `git ls-files`) to skip gitignored paths and files that a sparse checkout leaves out. Each call times out after 3 s and runs outside the extension host. Always off in untrusted workspaces.

contextDrift.gitStaleness.description: Turn on CD006 (stale file). It runs `git log`, read-only, outside the extension host. Off by default. Always off in untrusted workspaces.

contextDrift.staleDays.description: CD006: report an instruction file whose last commit is older than this many days...

contextDrift.staleCommits.description: ...and the repo has at least this many commits since.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Context Drift
walkthroughs.description: Find commands, paths and versions in your agent instruction files that no longer match the repo.

steps.title: Open an agent instruction file
steps.description:
Context Drift checks AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and Cline rules as soon as you open one.
[Open AGENTS.md](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22AGENTS.md%22%5D)
[Open CLAUDE.md](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22CLAUDE.md%22%5D)

steps.title: Check the whole workspace
steps.description:
Check every instruction file at once. Findings go to the Problems panel, and the status bar shows Drift: N.
[Check Workspace](command:contextDrift.checkWorkspace)

media.altText: AGENTS.md with five findings underlined, and the same five findings printed by the CLI.

steps.title: Fix a stale fact
steps.description:
Put the cursor on a squiggle and press Ctrl+. to replace a wrong script, path or package manager. A file with two or more fixes also gets "Apply all".
[Show Problems](command:workbench.actions.view.problems)

steps.title: Run the same check in CI
steps.description:
The CLI uses the same engine. Add it to a pull request check so drift never reaches main.
[Open Context Drift settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22contextDrift%22%5D)
